description: A node_retire that lifts the veto on an artifact in the network: the Spawner deletes the veto mark and brings up nothing (architecture §3.13.8). The common fields are in data.schema.json.

artifact_ref.description: The digest of the entry's image, which names the entry (implementation §1.2.11).

operator_proof.description: The operator's proof of the act, with act node_retire (implementation §9.2).
